answer: Pay epoch rewards into a vesting escrow instead of straight to wallets: payouts ripen over a dozen epochs and can be clawed back if the identity is ever exposed as a sybil. A farm's whole harvest sits like copper coins on a vine trellis, visible and revocable until ripe. Detection risk compounds: every month one puppet stays undetected, the entire pile rides on it. The operator cannot cash out fast, and extraction stops paying. Honest agents simply wait out the season.
